requirements.requirement: The system must expose an API endpoint that accepts evaluation requests with optional user-defined weights payload.
The system must validate incoming weight payloads against the schema defined in EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1 before processing.
The system must pass validated weight parameters into the scoring engine implemented in EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.
The system must return recomputed provider or clinical trial scores based on supplied weights.
The system must include metadata in the API response indicating whether custom weights or default weights were used.
The system must preserve existing evaluation behavior when no weights payload is provided.
The system must integrate weight handling into evaluate_care_facade without breaking existing orchestration flows.
The system must return a structured response containing scores, applied weights, and normalization details.
The system must reject requests with invalid weight formats and return a deterministic error response.
The system must fallback to default weights when partial weight inputs are provided and fill missing values.
The system must log incoming weight configurations and scoring outcomes for traceability.
The system must ensure API response latency remains within acceptable bounds when weights are applied.
The system must ensure idempotent behavior for identical requests with identical weight inputs.
The system must handle missing or null weight payloads without raising exceptions.
The system must return an explicit error when weight values fall outside allowed ranges defined in the schema.
